# WordPress - Web publishing software

WordPress, Git-ified. This repository is just a mirror of the [WordPress Subversion repository](https://build.trac.wordpress.org/browser/trunk), not designed for development.

Please do not send pull requests. Submit pull requests to the [`wordpress-develop` repository](https://github.com/WordPress/wordpress-develop) and patches to [Core Trac](https://core.trac.wordpress.org/) tickets instead.
